$comment: The product public page template (krizaka-internal#4636, design krizaka-internal#4692): structure only, no words (they are in messages `landing.productPage`). The scenes are the media the registry lists for `page`/`sceneRole`, in its order; the budget is the most words each section may say, held by lib/product-page.test.ts. `moment.flagged` is the index of the report line the pen marks; `limits` are the ids of the limits band's lines.
